'''Harbingers''' of the Dark Tide are humans who are chosen by [[Leviathan]] into becoming their agent to summon forth [[Tacet Discord]]s against the people of the land and spread its doctrine through force. Those chosen become corrupted and lose their identities as they become puppets to continue spreading Leviathan's influence until they perish.

==Synopsis==
Humans selected by the [[Threnodian]] Leviathan to spread its doctrine, and sow sorrow and despair among the masses. Influence appears to be a key factor in their selection. Marked by the Dark Tide's corruption, they wield fragments of Leviathan's power, such as summoning Its creations.

==In General==
Chosen by Leviathan, humans selected as the Dark Tide's Harbinger are those who summon the Tidespawn or any other manner of Tacet Discord from the Dark Tide itself through usage of Leviathan's power. Doing so allows Leviathan to spread its influence while also gathering "sustenance" from the emotions caused and created by the Harbinger themself. Once chosen, the target will find themselves marked in some manner which identifies their corruption. While this gives them influence and command over the Dark Tide's creations, in turn they slowly find themselves condemned to wander the Dark Tide's illusions as they become Leviathan's puppet. Unable to distinguish between dreams and reality, combined with memory loss over their own actions, Harbingers mistake the living for monsters and may even strike down those close to them and creating misjustice. 

While not impossible for a Harbinger to resist the power and influence of their status, unless one can defeat Leviathan, the only known method to escape being a Harbinger is to sacrifice one's own life. This is primarily due to the fact that the corruption itself cannot be removed, only resisted. 

==Qualifications==
Whenever a Harbinger is chosen, certain factors are picked to aid in spreading Leviathan's "gospel". While the majority of the qualifications are unknown, the two known factors would be their status and influence. 
* Harbingers of the Dark Tide must be an Anchor of Reality for all Tidespawn, meaning they must be a living person. 
* The second, if more preferable, is that Harbingers must be well-known and have a wide influence on the masses. Whether their reputation is positive or negative doesn't matter as long as numerous people among [[Rinascita]] are aware of them.

==Abilities==
Harbingers of the Dark Tide are known to wield fragments of Leviathan's powers, which in turns allow them to summon their creations. [[Fenrico]], a Harbinger of the Dark Tide, could use the power of Leviathan to call forth Tacet Discords to attack his enemies through his command over them and any other Dark Tide Creations. It could also be used to read others memories, such as when Fenrico used what remaining connection he had with the Dark Tide to read [[Qiuyuan]] past. 

A Harbinger's status also allows them to resonates with Rinasicta's darkest emotions. Using those emotions as an Anchor, these ties allow the Harbinger to spawn forth the Tidespawn into existence. The stronger these emotions are, the Harbinger's thoughts and memories could be used as a basis to quicken their evolution while also granting them forms they recall. This could potentially allow Tacet Discord of different regions to spawn forth in Rinascita depending on the chosen Harbinger. Though this ability can be passive and does not need the conscious action of the Harbinger for Tidespawn to be born. [[Rover]], an unwitting agent of Leviathan without knowledge of their status, brought forth numerous Tidespawn until they began suppressing their Resonance Ability so Tidespawn wouldn't surface upon being aware what they were.
